lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. A central vertical axis consists of three prominent, large-diameter blobs with high local maxima values.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, creating a structured grid pattern across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, irregular high-luminance patch is visible on the lower posterior flank, consistent with an epidermal abrasion or depigmented lesion.
other_distinctive_markers: Three distinct dark silhouettes of commensal fish (Echeneidae) are visible in the ventral water column below the pectoral fin.
